captions.detailed: A sit-down driving arcade cabinet styled in deep blue plastic. It features a molded seat pod, an integrated dashboard-style control console, and a vertical service face on the front. Built into this front face is a gray metallic coin door with an integrated coin-return flap. The coin door is designed to swing open on a vertical hinge, while the smaller coin-return flap rotates independently on a short horizontal hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a sit-down driving arcade cabinet in CadQuery. The model should feature a main blue cabinet body with a molded seat area, a separate gray coin door that rotates on a vertical hinge, and a smaller dark gray coin-return flap on the door that pivots on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: The arcade cabinet body is constructed using boolean operations on box primitives to carve out the seat pod, console area, and front coin door recess. The coin door is modeled as a flat plate with a rectangular cutout for the coin return. A separate coin-return flap is designed to fit inside this cutout. Two revolute joints are established: one with a vertical axis to swing the coin door open, and another with a horizontal axis to pivot the coin-return flap.
